title: The Lighter Brief
overview: A mixed bag of a holiday weekend: Thanksgiving storms soaked both US coasts and snarled travel, but skies should clear by Saturday as people head home. On the brighter side, Jamaica's Reggae Girlz booked another World Cup trip, a reggae legend revived a classic for hurricane relief, and a Charlotte mental health center turned ten.

stories.headline: Thanksgiving storms soak both coasts, but clearer skies are coming
stories.summary: Powerful storms hit the East Coast, the Midwest and the West Coast over Thanksgiving, causing flooding, fallen trees and widespread power outages. Hundreds of flights were cancelled or delayed during one of the busiest travel weeks of the year. Some bridges in New Jersey closed, and people were seen kayaking down streets in coastal Virginia. The storms are expected to move out and the tides to recede heading into Saturday.
key_facts: About 490,000 customers were without power Friday afternoon, per poweroutage.us
Nearly 201,000 of those were in New Jersey and Pennsylvania
Very high 'King Tides' have been hitting the West Coast
President Trump said he would consider releasing emergency funds
stories.why: If you're traveling home this weekend, check your flight and road conditions, though the weather should be improving by Saturday.

stories.headline: Justin Timberlake explains why he finally opened up for a docuseries
stories.summary: On The Tonight Show, Justin Timberlake told Jimmy Fallon he was 'really reluctant' to make a documentary about himself, calling himself 'famously private.' Conversations with director Fisher Stevens changed his mind, and he said the process turned out to be 'really cathartic.' He also celebrated 20 years of his album FutureSex/LoveSounds with live medleys.
key_facts: 'Timberlake' is a four-part series on Apple TV
Episodes 1–2 arrive Dec. 11, episode 3 on Dec. 18, and the finale on Dec. 23
It includes never-before-seen archival footage and interviews with family, including Jessica Biel
disputed: Confirmed: the series, its release dates and Timberlake's comments on the show

He didn't say which private stories he shares; per AllHipHop, the trailer revisits his 2004 Super Bowl appearance, his relationship with Britney Spears, and the arrest that led to a 2024 guilty plea on a reduced impaired-driving charge
stories.why: He says he hopes being open about his own struggles helps viewers going through hard times of their own.

stories.headline: North Carolina gas could jump 41 cents a gallon as tax break ends
stories.summary: North Carolina's temporary gas tax suspension, which lawmakers passed in October to ease the cost of living, is set to end. That's expected to raise prices by about 41 cents per gallon. Charlotte-area drivers and small businesses are bracing for it, and one lawmaker is considering extending the break through the holidays.
key_facts: Expected increase: about 41 cents per gallon
The General Assembly suspended the tax in October
A possible extension through the holidays is being considered, but has not been decided
stories.why: If you drive in North Carolina, filling up soon could save you a little money.

stories.headline: Jamaica's Justice Ministry rejects interference claim over legal honor
stories.summary: Jamaica's Ministry of Justice pushed back on a claim by PNP figure Paul Buchanan that attorney Hugh Wildman was denied the King's Counsel title over a political objection. The ministry, which didn't name either man, said appointments are decided on merit through a panel of senior lawyers and a committee chaired by the chief justice. It called the allegation 'unworthy and without merit.'
key_facts: Buchanan reportedly made the claim at an opposition PNP protest on Wednesday
The ministry said 'the prime minister is not involved in this process'
Applicants are assessed by existing King's Counsel, then by a committee chaired by the chief justice
stories.why: It's a public disagreement about whether one of Jamaica's top legal honors stays free of politics.

links.title: Ministry of Justice rejects accusations about interference in King’s Counsel appointment

stories.headline: Fort Mill water main break leaves some homes dry over the holiday
stories.summary: A water main break in Fort Mill left some customers with low or no water pressure on Friday. Crews have been working since 9 a.m. near Jackson Street and Ridge Road, where one lane is closed on each road. Some residents said it was the worst outage they'd seen.
key_facts: Location: Jackson Street and Ridge Road intersection
Crews have been on site since 9 a.m. Friday
One lane is closed in each direction at the intersection
stories.why: If you're in Fort Mill, expect spotty water pressure and lane closures near that intersection.

stories.headline: Reggae Girlz book a third straight Women's World Cup trip
stories.summary: Jamaica's women's team beat Costa Rica 3-0 in Texas to qualify for the 2027 FIFA Women's World Cup, their third in a row. The win also puts them in the W Championships semi-finals. Since Jamaica co-hosts the 2031 tournament, the team is now set for four straight World Cups.
key_facts: Goals came from Jody Brown, Kalyssa Van Zanten and captain Khadija 'Bunny' Shaw
Shaw's goal was her 68th in 50 appearances, and her seventh straight game with a goal
The 2027 World Cup runs June 24 to July 25; the draw is Dec. 11 in Brazil
stories.why: A big, joyful milestone for Jamaican football, with a star captain on a hot streak.

links.title: Reggae Girlz through to third straight World Cup after 3-0 win over Costa Rica

stories.headline: Produce prices dip at Kingston's Coronation Market
stories.summary: The Jamaica Observer's Market Bag team found several popular items selling for less this week at Coronation Market. Content creator Hakeem 'Uncle' Bryan joined the visit and joked that swinging prices have made him want to quit lettuce and tomatoes altogether.
key_facts: Tomatoes: $200 per pound
Scotch bonnet peppers: $300 per pound
Onions and Irish potatoes: $250 per pound each
Sorrel held steady at $600 per pound
stories.why: A bit of welcome relief at the market for shoppers in Kingston.

links.title: Market Bag: Prices dip as Uncle joins Observer at ‘Curry’

stories.headline: Ras Michael revives a 1975 classic to help Hurricane Melissa recovery
stories.summary: Reggae veteran Ras Michael has re-released 'None a Jah Jah Children No Cry' with Maxi Priest, Steel Pulse, Yami Bolo, his son Michael Nkrumah, and archival vocals from the late Sinéad O'Connor. All proceeds go to communities recovering from Hurricane Melissa, and every artist volunteered their time.
key_facts: The remix came out October 12, 2026, on the Zion Disc label
Funds will be managed through an Ethiopian Orthodox Tewahedo Church fund in LA and the Fly Away Foundation in Jamaica
Beneficiary communities haven't been chosen yet; a benefit concert is being planned
stories.why: A 50-year-old song of hope is being put to work helping people rebuild, and you can stream or download it now.

links.title: Ras Michael revives ‘None a Jah Jah Children No Cry’ for Hurricane Melissa relief
